fixes.what: The 896-989 corrections subtract the whole Cliopatria Aquitaine 895 shape, which is all of southern France (Toulouse, Septimania/Narbonne, Gascony/Bordeaux, Auvergne), not only the duchy the page calls 'largely outside the control' of the kings; the base shape stops at 45.5-45.65 N and no dossier owns the removed land.
fixes.why: Resolved: the 896-910 correction is 750 cells (189,675 km2, bbox south edge 45.53 N) against Cliopatria's 375,679 km2; 926-989 is 663/661 cells (about 167,000 km2) against 354,590 / 354,017 km2 (ratio 0.47). Toulouse (13 cells within 30 km), Narbonne (8) and Bordeaux (11) are in the subtracted Aquitaine 895 shape and in no corrected keyframe. The batch notes (_notes/eu-07-e.md) say Toulouse, Septimania, Gascony and the Spanish March 'are inside the base shape': false for 888-989. The vassal counterpart 'aquitaine' is a Cliopatria row that ends in 895 (and its dossier, eu-07, has not run), while the report asks for 'duchy-of-aquitaine' 896-989; neither will draw 896-989 unless routed. The West Francia page sentence ('Although Aquitaine did not become a separate kingdom, it was largely outside the control of the West Frankish kings') names Aquitaine only. The vassal region also overlaps County of Rosellon 896 (16 cells) and County of Berga 898 (3 cells).
fixes.fix: Either (a, recommended, the author's own fallback) revert the eight 896-980 corrections to the Cliopatria shapes (keep the 936 union with Upper Burgundy 936) and keep or drop the 889/989 vassal pair as tint only, or (b) subtract only the duchy proper (Poitou, Limousin, Auvergne, Berry by admin1/region names) and keep Toulouse, Septimania/Gothia and Gascony in the base shape; in either case make the vassal counterpart the slug that will own the land 896-989 (duchy-of-aquitaine or an extended aquitaine) and correct the notes sentence.
